description: Sistema infrastrutturale ferroviario is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cloud.ldpgis.it. Linear dataset of the railway infrastructure system of the Tuscany Region. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Railway infrastructure system" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Piano Strutturale, Urbanistica, Trasporti. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
